scope: Fixed Euclidean versus TRAIN old-head/new-gold task-score nearest projection under common rank-frontier protection; exposed development adaptation

training.source_checkpoint_selection: Reuse audited NewEntityOnly common VALID selected checkpoint; exposed development source
training.metric_cohort: New TRAIN old head / new gold only; fixed source oldE/R
limits: Known learned-proposal and task-score Mahalanobis projection, not confirmed algorithmic novelty.
Strict guard cutoff/count contract on selected old TRAIN initially retained members only; no all-TEST rank guarantee.
Projection failures yield zero, and useful learning requires the registered utility screen.
SVD uses all-relation TRUE directions and trained proposals, not native analytic single-edit Rank formula.
Original source SGD, basis preparation and postprocessing costs must be reported separately.
